summary: Frontend testing completed for me&you iteration 6 - Coin Economy UI Migration. All major features tested and working. Fixed 1 bug: Feed.jsx was showing EUR prices instead of coins for unlock buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed Feed.jsx line 109: Changed from EUR (it.unlock_price.toFixed(2)€) to coins (Math.round(it.unlock_price * 10) coins)
All coin economy UI elements properly implemented with data-testid attributes
WalletChip correctly polls /api/wallet every 15s and listens to 'wallet-refresh' events
Subscribe/tip/unlock flows correctly debit coins and update wallet chip live
Payout button correctly disabled when balance < 500 coins minimum
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coin economy UI fully tested. All payment flows use coins. Stripe only used for buying coin packs via /wallet page. Fan balance after tests: ~480 coins. Fan subscribed to Clara Nuit and Sophie Luxe during testing.
